meta.title: MAS-by-KSI coverage
meta.statement: Providers SHOULD apply ALL Key Security Indicators to ALL aspects of their cloud service offering that are within the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope.
meta.note: Advisory surface for FRC-CSX-MAS (SHOULD). A cell is demonstrated only because the provider named a test method or evidence in the KSI record that covers this resource and it resolves; nothing is inferred. This report sets no status and is not a compliance determination.
